about: All eight are ideas for one app called Project Hub: the place where a studio keeps the brief and all the information for each of its projects.
glyphs: An open folder with one sheet of paper sticking out of it, the sheet with two short lines of writing.
A hub: one larger circle in the middle joined by short thick spokes to four smaller circles around it.
A clipboard with a clip at the top and a three-item checklist on it.
Three sheets of paper fanned out like a hand of cards, the front one with a folded corner and lines of writing.
A ring binder seen from the front, closed, with three index tabs sticking out of its right side.
A sheet of paper with a folded corner and three lines of writing, held by a round pushpin at the top.
A board with three columns of small cards of different heights, like a project board.
A document with a small target, three rings and a centre dot, overlapping its bottom corner.
